title: A category made from the inventory part dialog is priced for every tier
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use the staging site with the Tiered Pricing release (and the Tiered Pricing QA site too, once it exists); production is not needed.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, so the Categories list has a tier column to read.
  • Have a new inventory part for this test, part A.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open part A in the inventory.
  2. Create a new category from part A's category field, named with a name no other category uses.
  3. Save the part.
  4. Open Settings › Categories.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A's dialog opens with its category field.

Step 2:

  • The new category is created and picked for part A.

Step 3:

  • Part A saves in the new category.

Step 4:

  • The new category is listed.
  • Its Default and tier A cells show a rule or "Uses previous tier", none empty.
